reviews.text: The massage was heavenly. Getting an appointment was not: the online booking shows every slot as taken, then they tell you on the phone it's empty.
Really appreciated paying $40 extra for a 'hot stone upgrade' with lukewarm stones. Five stars for creativity.
Emailed about a couples package, no reply. Called, no answer. Gave up.
The best spa experience I've ever had. Worth every cent!!
Receptionist was lovely but kept switching to French and I couldn't follow the aftercare explanation.

reviews.evidence: Treatment excellent, but the scheduling page wrongly displays no availability.
Paid for a premium add-on that did not deliver as promised.
Neither written enquiries nor calls got any response.
Described as the finest treatment ever, entirely worth the price.
Post-treatment advice given mostly in French, hard for the guest to understand.
